source_caption_text:
🚨 DIDDY ALLEGEDLY BEATEN BY NOTORIOUS JAMAICAN DRUG KINGPIN — RUSHED TO HOSPITAL! 😳

Sean “Diddy” Combs reportedly got into a prison fight with Christopher “Dudus” Coke, one of Jamaica’s most notorious convicted drug kingpins, and allegedly suffered a serious head injury!

According to TMZ, the two exchanged blows inside FCI Fort Dix after inmates became furious over an NBC News report exposing Diddy's allegedly luxurious prison lifestyle.

🔥 HERE'S THE CRAZY PART!

The report allegedly triggered multiple prison raids, with correctional officers confiscating cell phones and other privileges from inmates — including Dudus.

TMZ's sources claim Dudus was furious about losing those privileges, and the confrontation turned physical.

🚑 DIDDY GOT THE WORST OF IT!

According to TMZ, Diddy's injuries were serious enough that prison officials transported him by ambulance to an outside medical facility early Saturday morning.

Both men reportedly received two weeks in the Special Housing Unit following the altercation.

And here's the twist: Diddy might be the biggest celebrity in that prison, but TMZ's sources describe DUDUS as the REAL KINGPIN behind those walls!

Imagine being worth hundreds of millions at your peak, only to end up fighting one of Jamaica's most infamous drug lords over confiscated prison phones.

👀 WHO DO YOU THINK WAS REALLY RUNNING THAT PRISON — DIDDY OR DUDUS?

Source: TMZ, October 14, 2026. Details of the alleged fight are attributed to TMZ's prison sources and have not been independently verified.
